title: Rate-limit failed logins
author: example-author
summary: This PR adds rate limiting to the login process by locking accounts for 15 minutes after 5 failed login attempts, improving security against brute force attacks.

groups.title: Implement rate limiting logic for failed login attempts
groups.summary: Introduces a new module to track and count failed login attempts within a 15-minute window, enabling account lockout after too many failures.

groups.title: Integrate rate limiting into login flow
groups.summary: Modifies the login function to check for too many failed attempts and raise an error if the limit is exceeded, and records each login attempt's success or failure.

groups.title: Handle rate limit errors in API route
groups.summary: Updates the login API route to catch the rate limit exception and respond with a 429 status code and appropriate error message.

groups.title: Add redis dependency to requirements
groups.summary: Adds the redis package to requirements.txt, presumably for future use or related to rate limiting.

@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+import time
+
+_FAILED: dict[str, list[float]] = {}
+WINDOW_SECONDS = 15 * 60
+
+def attempts(username: str) -> int:
+    now = time.time()
+    recent = [t for t in _FAILED.get(username, []) if now - t < WINDOW_SECONDS]
+    _FAILED[username] = recent
+    return len(recent)
+
+def record_attempt(username: str, ok: bool) -> None:
